title: Smart Data Models - HSDS - Organization
description: The details about each organization delivering services. Each service should be linked to the organization responsible for its delivery. One organization may deliver many services. (Human Services Data Specification 3.3.1, object 'organization': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json. Field names are kept verbatim (snake_case) except 'id' -> 'hsdsId'.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity (NGSI-LD): urn:ngsi-ld:Organization:<HSDS id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Organization'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hsdsId.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/id'. The identifier for the organization. Each organization must have a unique identifier. HSDS field 'id', renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/name'. The official or public name of the organization.

alternate_name.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/alternate_name'. An (optional) alternative or commonly used name for the organization.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/description'. A free text description containing a brief summary about the organization. It can contain markup such as HTML or Markdown.

email.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/email'. The contact e-mail address for the organization.

website.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/website'. The URL (website address) of the organization.

additional_websites.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/additional_websites'. The details of additional websites for the organization.

year_incorporated.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/year_incorporated'. The year in which the organization was legally formed.

legal_status.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/legal_status'. The legal conditions that an organization is operating under.

logo.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/logo'. A URL to an image associated with the organization which can be presented alongside its name.

uri.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/uri'. A persistent identifier to uniquely identify the organization such as those provided by Open Corporates or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the website field of the Organization.

parent_organization_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/parent_organization_id'. The identifier of the organization's parent organization. In HSDS this is an HSDS identifier (uuid); here it holds the URN of the Organization entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Organization:<HSDS id>).

funding.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/funding'. The sources of funding for a service or organization.

contacts.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/contacts'. The details of the named contacts for services and organizations.

phones.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/phones'. The details of the telephone numbers are used to contact organizations, services, and locations.

locations.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/locations'. The details of the locations where organizations operate. Locations may be virtual, and one organization may have many locations. In HSDS this is embedded HSDS objects; here it holds the URN of the Location entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Location:<HSDS id>).

programs.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/programs'. The details of collection of related services. In HSDS this is embedded HSDS objects; here it holds the URN of the Program entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Program:<HSDS id>).

organization_identifiers.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/organization_identifiers'. The details of the third party identifiers for organizations, such as: company registration number, charity number, tax registration number.

attributes.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/attributes'. A link between a service and one or more classifications that describe the nature of the service provided.

metadata.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/organization.json#/properties/metadata'. A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.

id.description: The identifier of the attribute entry. Each attribute entry should have a unique identifier.

taxonomy_term_id.title: Taxonomy Term Identifier
taxonomy_term_id.description: The identifier of this taxonomy term from the taxonomy table.

link_type.title: Link Type
link_type.description: A code taken from an enumerated open codelist to indicate what the taxonomy term describes, e.g. the service eligibility or intended audience.

link_entity.title: Link Entity
link_entity.description: The table of the Link Identifier.

value.title: Value

taxonomy_term.title: Taxonomy Term
taxonomy_term.description: Each service can be categorized according to one or more taxonomy terms. The taxonomy_term object contains a list of taxonomy terms, their names, and, for hierarchical taxonomies, their structure.

updated_by.title: Updated By

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for the phone number. Each entry must have a unique identifier.

location_id.title: Location Identifier
location_id.description: The identifier of the location where this phone number is located.

service_id.title: Service Identifier
service_id.description: The identifier of the service for which this is the phone number.

organization_id.title: Organization Identifier
organization_id.description: The identifier of the organization for which this is the phone number.

contact_id.title: Contact Identifier
contact_id.description: The identifier of the contact for which this is the phone number.

service_at_location_id.title: Service At Location Identifier
service_at_location_id.description: The identifier of the ‘service at location’ table entry, when this phone number is specific to a service in a particular location.

extension.title: Extension
extension.description: The extension of the phone number.

type.title: Type
type.description: Indicates the type of phone service, drawing from the RFC6350 list of types (text (for SMS), voice, fax, cell, video, pager, textphone).

description.title: Description

The taxonomy_term object contains a list of taxonomy terms, their names, and, for hierarchical taxonomies, their structure. (HSDS object 'taxonomy_term': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/taxonomy_term.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for this taxonomy term. Each taxonomy term must have a unique identifier, within the scope of the dataset.

code.title: Code
code.description: The term identfier as used in the taxonomy. This and the taxonomy_id combined define the term.

description.title: Description
description.description: A free text description of the term.

parent_id.title: Parent Identifier
parent_id.description: If this is a child term in a hierarchical taxonomy, give the identifier of the parent category. For top-level categories, this is not required.

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.description: If this is an established taxonomy, a free text description of which taxonomy is in use. If possible, provide a URI.

taxonomy_detail.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy_detail.description: Taxonomies from which taxonomy terms are taken

language.title: Language
language.description: An ISO 639-1, ISO 639-2, or ISO 639-3 [language code](http://www.loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php) to represent the language of the term. The three-letter codes from ISO 639-2 and ISO 639-3 provide greater accuracy when describing variants of languages, which may be relevant to particular communities.
